title: Build isolated upstream e2e runner container

acceptance_criteria.description: Pinned additive runner image builds and original compiled e2e test/service discovery succeeds inside restricted Docker.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Actual Docker build and image/binary/test discovery receipt; distinguish discovery from executed tests and missing backend stack.

acceptance_criteria.description: Container boundaries, existing harness and migration/default preservation validate.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Focused boundary tests, migration/scope/diff checks and unchanged Haskell source/defaults.

evidence.command: Actual pinned Docker build and restricted non-root no-network preflight: original compiled integration/service binaries present, five proxy and 27 cargohold functions discovered. This is discovery, not executed e2e assertions; backend stack remains unprovisioned.

42 parity/container unit tests, migration checker/32 tests, scoped diff/whitespace checks; original Haskell code/default charts/build inputs unchanged. Empty/failed/skipped reports and missing environment cannot pass.

handoff: Container runner built and actual original compiled-suite discovery succeeded without installing host Haskell/backend packages. Immutable local image/binary/input receipts retained. Complete e2e environment still requires task-owned dependency and static-peer containers/fixtures; no full e2e success or service promotion claimed. All commits remain local on go-migration.
